To make it worse, it keeps giving me broken 15-second clips instead of the 60-second video I ordered. Even the AI support chat acknowledged the error but said they can't refund credits from there. I have tried contacting human support multiple times, and they [...] I am currently facing what appears to be an attempt to charge me twice for a subscription, and resolving the issue has been unnecessarily difficult. CapCut makes it confusing to understand which account or subscription is connected to which email, especially when using different devices or trying to connect existing desktop projects to the correct account.

What makes the situation even more frustrating is the lack of accessible customer support. Finding a proper help center or a straightforward way to contact someone and resolve a billing issue is incredibly difficult.

For a company that charges users for subscriptions and stores their projects in its ecosystem, account and subscription management should be simple and transparent.
